subject: general
question: The Annual Financial Statement, which is presented as a part of budget, is covered under which Article of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 112**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Annual Financial Statement, **which is presented as a part of the budget, is covered under **Article 112 of the Constitution of India.**
 
• It states that the annual financial statement, also known as the statement of the estimated income and expenditures of the Government of India for each fiscal year, shall be placed before **both Houses of Parliament by the President.**
 
• Every financial year, as part of the budgeting process, a document called the Annual Financial Statement is delivered to Parliament.
 
• The records include the government's receipts and outlays for the current fiscal year, the prior fiscal year, and the budget year in three distinct parts: the Consolidated Fund of India, the Contingency Fund of India, and the Public Account of India.
